question: Two identical resistors are connected in parallel to a 12 V battery. The total power dissipated in the circuit is 6 W. The current in each resistor is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.25 A**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Given:**

 
 
• Two identical resistors
 
• Connected in parallel
 
• Battery voltage (V) = 12 V
 
• Total power dissipated (P) = 6 W
 
 
 
• **To find:**
 
 
• Current in each resistor
 
 
 
• **Solution:**
 
 
• **Step 1 – Find the equivalent resistance (R′):**
 
 
• Using the power formula:
 
• P = V²/Req
 
• 6 = 12²/ Rₑq
 
• Rₑq= 24 Ω
 
 
 
• **Step 2 – Find individual resistor value (R):**
 
 
• For two identical resistors in parallel: 
 
• 1/Rₑq =1/R + 1/R = 2/R
 
• R=2×Rₑq​ = 2×24=48Ω
 
 
 
• **Step 3 – Find the current through each resistor:**
 
 
• Each resistor gets full voltage (12 V):
 
• I = V/R =12/48 = 0.25A
